headline: Executive order keeps the council that reviews the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) in operation.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order extends the life of the FEMA Review Council, a group set up to study how the federal disaster agency works. No summary was provided, so details such as how long the council will continue or whether its duties changed are not known.

who_it_affects.how: They would continue their review work instead of the council ending.
The agency would remain under review by the council.
